name: Narukami Aoi
source: A sophomore and the present Orihime candidate of the Tower of Power. Despite looking young she is a master at various martial arts, and carries around a naginata everywhere. She gets angry every time somebody calls her "SD Samurai" or "Deformed Samurai". Despite being a tsundere, she sometimes has mature thoughts and shows her polite side.
